description: Get the PDF of an order: Angebot (AN, quote), Auftragsbestätigung (AB) or Lieferschein (LI), e.g. to show, check or forward it. Read-only preview: it is fetched with preventSendBy, so it never marks the order as sent or commits it, and its status and editability stay as they are. The result holds the file's metadata and a resource link; the client loads the file itself via resources/read, its content is never put into the text. To save a copy to disk or as a download link use sevdesk_document_save (available with SEVDESK_OUTPUT_DIR or on a remote server). Find the id with the order list tools first.

id.description: sevDesk id of the document (not its number such as RE-1001).

name: sevdesk_order_pdf
title: Get an order PDF
